decisions.title: Hive Architecture Adoption
decisions.summary: Deployed physical directory structure for all agents with dedicated memory and resources. Solves context persistence (GAP-4, GAP-7, GAP-8).

decisions.title: LEX Compliance Mandate (Lightweight)
decisions.summary: LEX/OPS absorbs protocol compliance via lightweight checklist. Team voted unanimously with conditions: ~3 productions/week, 30-day monitoring, exit to PROTOCOL hive if overwhelmed.

decisions.title: Code Archaeologist Infrastructure Classification
decisions.summary: ARCH positioned as Infrastructure agent (knowledge preservation). Pattern library is system-wide resource, Phase 0 in delivery pipeline. Team vote: 8-0 Infrastructure.
decisions.rationale: Primary value is infrastructure (enables compound learning). Analysis work is method, not identity. Peer group: SCRIBE, RAM CREW, RELAY, LEX.
